parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the signal handler setup (lines 16-18) and confirmed it occurs before the fork (line 25). The child process sends SIGINT only after a 1‑second sleep (lines 31-33). The parent calls pause() after the fork (line 36). Since the handler is installed before the fork, any SIGINT sent by the child will be caught immediately, regardless of whether pause() has been called. If the signal were delivered before pause(), pause() would return immediately upon the pending signal. Thus there is no exploitable race condition between fork() and pause().
